description: Header file defining the HalProxy class and related interfaces for managing sensor HAL interactions, subHALs, and wakelocks in Android's sensor framework.

classes.name: HalProxy
classes.description: Main class managing sensor subHALs, event queues, wakelocks, and sensor operations.

classes.name: IHalProxy
classes.description: Template interface enabling HAL version-specific implementations.

methods.name: getSensorsList_2_1
methods.description: Retrieves the list of sensors for HAL 2.1.

methods.name: initialize_2_1
methods.description: Initializes the sensor HAL with event and wakelock queues for HAL 2.1.

methods.name: injectSensorData_2_1
methods.description: Injects sensor event data for HAL 2.1.

methods.name: getSensorsList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of sensors for HAL 2.0.

methods.name: setOperationMode
methods.description: Sets the operation mode for sensors.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the sensor HAL with event and wakelock queues for HAL 2.0.

methods.name: batch
methods.description: Configures batch parameters for a sensor.

methods.name: registerDirectChannel
methods.description: Registers a direct channel for sensor data.

methods.name: configDirectReport
